title: Quantifying Non-linearity in Topology Optimization with similarity based Visualization
summary: Topology optimization (TO) can be viewed as seeking an optimal solution in the design space of a given TO problem. For weakly non-linear TO problems, e.g., compliance minimization, sensitivity-based methods typically converge well, whereas for strongly non-linear problems, e.g., maximum stress minimization, stabilization strategies such as stabilization terms and projection functions are often required to enhance convergence.
